Rehoboth Beach non-profits ranked by government grant revenue in 2024
E. W. Hare
Rehoboth Beach, Delaware non-profits in 2024 were led by Rehoboth Beach Public Library, which reported $3,813,430 in government grant revenue in its IRS Form 990 filing and $3,942,572 in total revenue. Government grants made up 96.7% of its reported total revenue.
The ranking reflects non-profits with available Form 990-series government grant revenue data that met the ranking's data criteria and may not include every non-profit in the city.
The ranking is based on IRS Form 990 filings, the annual information returns most tax-exempt organizations file with the IRS. The form includes reported revenue, expenses, assets, governance information and compensation paid to certain people, making it a public source for comparing large tax-exempt organizations' finances.
The figures reflect what each organization reported for its filing year, including total revenue, contributions, government grants, compensation, the number of employees and assets at the start and end of the year. Because nonprofits can differ by mission, structure and accounting period, the totals are best read as reported financial measures, not as a direct measure of local charitable activity.
Among the 7 ranked organizations with calculable government-grant shares, the median share of revenue from government grants was 27.8%. Rehoboth Beach Public Library also recorded the highest share at 96.7%.
Rehoboth Beach Public Library's current-year government grant revenue of $3,813,430 increased from $482,509 the prior year, rising by $3,330,921, or 690.3%. Indian River Volunteer Fire Company Inc's government grant revenue grew to $1,368,969 from $1,176,322, an increase of $192,647, or 16.4%. Cape Henlopen Senior Center Inc saw government grant revenue decrease to $680,778 from $859,286, a reduction of $178,508, or 20.8%. Camp Rehoboth Inc.'s government grant revenue decreased to $497,746 from $601,361, down $103,615, or 17.2%. Community Resource Center Inc reported government grant revenue of $133,000, up from $10,896 the previous year, a $122,104 increase, or 1,120.6%. Developing Artist Collaboration reported $83,766 in government grant revenue, an increase of $1,481, or 1.8% over the prior year.
Rehoboth Beach Public Library reported $3,871,716 in total contributions; of that total, $58,286 was categorized as all other contributions. Its asset balances rose from $1,299,687 at the beginning of the year to $4,604,680 at yearend, an increase of 254.3%.
Tax-exempt organizations include a wide range of groups, such as charities, foundations, educational institutions and other mission-driven organizations. Under IRS rules, 501(c)(3) organizations must be organized and operated for exempt purposes, and their earnings cannot benefit private shareholders or individuals.
